scripts.dev: node scripts/db.mjs migrate dev && node scripts/dev-api.mjs
scripts.dev:api: npm run build && node scripts/db.mjs migrate dev && node scripts/dev-api.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4 deploy
scripts.demo:seed: node scripts/demo-data.mjs seed > demo-data.sql && node scripts/db.mjs exec main demo-data.sql
scripts.demo:remove: node scripts/demo-data.mjs remove > demo-data.sql && node scripts/db.mjs exec main demo-data.sql
